narr: Thunderstorms moved westward into the Tucson Metro area the afternoon and evening of September 6th bringing flash flooding of multiple washes having at least 6 inches of moving water. Additionally, the thunderstorm winds caused multiple power poles to be downed causing a power outage on the west side of the Tucson Metro.
ev: Heavy rainfall from thunderstorm heavy rainfall caused several washes to flow along South San Joaquin Road between West Milkyway Drive and Bopp Road with at least 6 inches of water and debris along the road.
lsr: Trained Spotter reported several washes flowing along South San Joaquin Road between West Milkyway Drive and Bopp Road with at least 6 inches of water and debris along the road.
